headline_0949.leakage_status: FIXED. Original AUROC=1.000/R2=0.9996 were CIRCULAR (input embedding positions 4-9 = log1p per-species counts define the occupancy label). Retrained with those removed.
headline_0949.caveat_acknowledged_in_repo: README/summary already state 0.949 is 'mostly a geographic range prior; env-only floor ~0.85; widespread mussel 0.88 = genuine signal'. Rare-species AUROC (trout/eel ~0.98) is a lat/lon range prior, not env skill.

env_mechanism.baselines_regularized: GBM l2=1.0 max_iter=300 lr=0.05 class_weight=balanced applied identically to S0/S1/S3 -> baselines NOT straw-men
env_mechanism.verdict: MIXED. 'env beats the geography-free PROXY floor' is robust (CI excludes 0). But 'env 0.818 > geo-only 0.791' as a STANDALONE beat is NOT statistically robust: the paired env-vs-geo delta CI [-0.017,+0.068] includes 0 (p=0.891). The JSON's own VERDICT correctly claims mechanism vs the S0 proxy floor, not vs geo-only.
